draft.title: Longitude and time difference
card: The Earth turns 360° in 24 hours. So it turns 360° ÷ 24 = 15° each hour.
This means every 15° of longitude is about 1 hour of time difference. To find the time difference, find the difference in longitude, then divide by 15.
The Earth turns towards the east, so places further east are ahead in time. Places further west are behind.
Example: Place A is at 150°E and place B is at 120°E. The difference is 150° − 120° = 30°. 30° ÷ 15 = 2 hours. A is further east, so A is 2 hours ahead of B.
draft.remember: Divide the longitude difference by 15 to get hours. East is ahead, west is behind.

a.q: Two towns are 45° of longitude apart. About how many hours apart are their times?
a.why: The Earth turns 15° each hour, so 45° ÷ 15 = 3 hours. Dividing by 24 instead of 15 gives about 1.9, which is a different rule and does not match 15° per hour.
a.clue: Divide the degrees by the number of degrees in one hour.

b.q: Town P is at 30°E and town Q is at 75°W. Both are on the same day. About what is the time difference, and which town is ahead?
b.why: P is east and Q is west of the prime meridian, so add the angles: 30° + 75° = 105°. 105° ÷ 15 = 7 hours. P is further east, so P is ahead. Subtracting 75° from 30° gives 45°, which is the error when the two sides are not added.
b.clue: The towns are on opposite sides of 0°, so the angles join together.

proposal.title: Longitude and time difference
card: The Earth turns 360° in 24 hours, so it turns 360° ÷ 24 = 15° each hour. This means every 15° of longitude is about 1 hour of time difference.
if both places are east, or both are west, subtract the longitudes. For 150°E and 120°E: 150° − 120° = 30°, and 30° ÷ 15 = 2 hours.
if one place is east and one is west of 0°, add the longitudes. For 45°E and 15°W: 45° + 15° = 60°, and 60° ÷ 15 = 4 hours.
The Earth turns towards the east, so the place further east is ahead in time. So 150°E is 2 hours ahead of 120°E, and 45°E is 4 hours ahead of 15°W.
proposal.remember: Same side, subtract. Opposite sides, add. Divide by 15, and east is ahead.
